routing_input_rule.no_source_averaging: no pooled or cross-source averaged statistic exists or is computed; a stage PASS needs every planned source/panel PASS, so no source can rescue another source's frozen-gate failure
routing_input_rule.residual_source_order_dependence: the frozen stage rule takes the first non-PASS invocation, so when one source would FAIL and another would be NOT_ESTIMABLE, the stage status (FAIL vs NOT_ESTIMABLE) depends on which runs first; this is replay fidelity and is not changed
routing_input_rule.routing_v2_universal_source_input: FAIL is reserved for formally established source heterogeneity and is never produced; NOT_ESTIMABLE if any stage is NOT_ESTIMABLE; otherwise PASS. Routing V2 rules 1 (universal FAIL) and 9 (universal NOT_ESTIMABLE) therefore never change a route: the route is exactly the frozen TD56 -> TD57B -> TD57C -> TD59 stage hierarchy, a function of the four stage statuses only
routing_input_rule.source_heterogeneity: UNRESOLVED__NO_PROSPECTIVELY_FROZEN_DIRECT_BETWEEN_SOURCE_TEST for every stage; Pattern G (source-specific disagreement) is never assigned in this replay
routing_input_rule.source_order_censoring: source/panels not run because of the frozen sequential stop are missing evidence, recorded as UNOBSERVED; they are never counted as agreement or as disagreement
routing_input_rule.stage_inputs: the frozen stage status (PASS/FAIL/NOT_ESTIMABLE); an IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE yields no routing input
routing_input_rule.threshold_discordance: a PASS and a FAIL on the same stage and panel is recorded descriptively as failure to establish universality; it is not a between-source test and is never labelled source heterogeneity
routing_input_rule.universal_qualification: per stage, descriptive: ESTABLISHED only when every planned source/panel execution was observed and passed its frozen per-source gate (stage PASS); NOT_ESTABLISHED when an observed execution failed its frozen gate (stage FAIL); otherwise the stage status. Each record lists the observed per-source outcomes, the source/panels the frozen sequential stop left unobserved, and any same-panel PASS/FAIL threshold discordance
